meta.title: Modern Luxury Bedroom 1 (4.9m x 4.0m) - Bedside Detail

physical_properties.bed: king size upholstered bed with tall channel-tufted ivory boucle headboard mounted on a freestanding walnut-panelled headboard wall, slim low-profile frame, bed floating in the middle of the room
physical_properties.bedding: crisp white sateen sheets, champagne silk-look duvet folded back at the foot, layered euro shams and two lumbar pillows in taupe velvet, chunky knit throw draped at an angle
physical_properties.nightstand: walnut veneer nightstand with fluted drawer front and brushed brass pulls, travertine top
physical_properties.lamp: sculptural ceramic table lamp with pleated linen shade, switched off
physical_properties.finish: rich mix of matte, velvet, boucle and brushed metal textures

foreground.notes: end-of-bed bench in taupe velvet, softly out of focus

midground.notes: stack of two coffee-table books, small brass tray with a glass carafe, a bud vase with a single white ranunculus, a slim gold alarm clock

background.notes: freestanding walnut-panelled half-height wall with integrated warm LED strip along the top edge (off), glimpse of the doorway to the ensuite visible past one end
floor-to-ceiling glass sliding doors with sheer ivory curtains and greige linen drapes pulled open; glimpse of balcony and soft greenery beyond
small blown-glass pendants on brass rods, off

surface.details: wide-plank light oak floor with a plush cream wool rug under the bed

background.texture: limewash plaster wall in warm greige

palette.notes: ivory, greige and taupe base with champagne brass, walnut and a touch of deep slate

atmosphere.mood: serene, elegant, boutique-hotel calm on a fresh morning

camera.focus_point: headboard wall, pillows and the nightstand on the window side
camera.position: standing near the long left wall, off to the window side, looking toward the bed and headboard wall at a slight angle

lighting.key_light_source: morning sunlight through the balcony sliding doors, filtered by sheer curtains
lighting.notes: soft sunbeams falling across the bedding, gentle shadows, no artificial lights on

style.rendering: photorealistic interior photography, architectural digest editorial quality

room_layout.bed_wall: bed centered in the room, headboard toward the right side (the ensuite side); bed faces the long solid wall on the left
room_layout.window_wall: short wall to the bed's left side as you lie in it (camera right): wide floor-to-ceiling glass sliding doors opening to a balcony with a pale stone deck
room_layout.entry_door: near the corner beside the headboard wall, on the side away from the window; out of frame
room_layout.ensuite_opening: wide opening between two walk-in robes, hidden behind the freestanding headboard wall
room_layout.clearances: about 0.8m walkway behind the headboard wall, about 0.9m on each side of the bed, and roughly 0.75m to 1.6m between the foot of the bed and the left wall depending on room orientation
room_layout.headboard_feature_wall: freestanding headboard wall about 1.2m high and the width of the bed plus nightstands, finished in walnut panelling with the ivory boucle headboard mounted on it; set about 0.8m in front of the ensuite opening, so the robes and ensuite are reached by walking around either end
room_layout.opposite_wall: the long left wall facing the foot of the bed: low walnut console with styled objects and large abstract art above it
